title: CoreWeave closes $2.6 billion GPU-backed loan
excerpt: The approximately five-year debt finances deployments backed by customer contracts averaging three years, requiring lenders to underwrite renewal or re-leasi...
content_html:
CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) closed a $2.6 billion delayed-draw term loan on Monday, priced at SOFR plus 550 bps with a maturity of approximately five years. The debt was issued by CoreWeave Financing DDTL V-V, LLC to fund HPC infrastructure for committed customer deployments.

Moody's rated the transaction Ba2, while Fitch assigned a BB+ rating. CoreWeave said the loan was oversubscribed, though it did not disclose the order book, allocation or amount drawn at closing.

The collateral structure departs from CoreWeave's earlier delayed-draw loans. Customer contracts supporting the new debt average approximately three years, leaving about two years between the average initial contract expiration and the loan's maturity. CoreWeave can renew those contracts or re-lease the GPU capacity, subject to requirements in the credit agreement.

CoreWeave said the structure expands the range of contracts that can receive infrastructure financing through public syndication. The underlying commitments come from AI customers and enterprises in other sectors, but the company did not identify them. Shorter contracts often carry higher prices, which CoreWeave expects will support higher margins and help it serve customers unwilling to sign longer agreements.

"This transaction demonstrates the continued evolution and growing flexibility of AI infrastructure financing and represents a major unlock for CoreWeave," said Brannin McBee, co-founder and chief development officer. "Lenders are now comfortable financing shorter-dated contracts, which allows us to target a wider variety of customers, including global enterprises that typically favor shorter-term agreements."

The transaction follows CoreWeave's $3.1 billion DDTL 5.0 loan, completed in May with an approximately 5.5-year maturity. That debt priced at SOFR plus 450 bps, making the new loan's spread 100 bps wider. Both transactions received Ba2 and BB+ ratings from Moody's and Fitch, respectively.

CoreWeave said the latest closing brought its debt and equity capital secured during 2026 to more than $30 billion. The total includes equity and other debt transactions, rather than only the company's delayed-draw loans. CoreWeave reported $98.8 billion of revenue backlog as of March 31, based on its definition covering remaining performance obligations and other committed contract amounts.

The delayed-draw structure lets CoreWeave fund infrastructure as customer deployments proceed, rather than borrowing the full amount at closing. The company did not provide a draw schedule or state whether the debt has recourse to the parent.

The transaction's joint lead arrangers and bookrunners were JPMorgan and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group. Proceeds will finance the purchase and deployment of customer-dedicated GPU infrastructure.

content_html_zh:
CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）周一关闭了一笔 26 亿美元的延迟提取定期贷款，定价为 SOFR 加 550 个基点，期限约为五年。 该债务由 CoreWeave Financing DDTL V-V, LLC 发行，为承诺的客户部署的 HPC 基础设施提供资金。

穆迪对本次交易给予 Ba2 评级，惠誉则给予 BB+ 评级。 CoreWeave 表示，这笔贷款已超额认购，但没有透露订单簿、分配或成交时提取的金额。

抵押品结构与 CoreWeave 早期的延迟提取贷款不同。 支持新债务的客户合同平均约为三年，平均初始合同到期与贷款到期之间还有大约两年的时间。 CoreWeave 可以根据信贷协议中的要求续签这些合同或重新租赁 GPU 容量。

CoreWeave 表示，该结构扩大了可以通过公共银团获得基础设施融资的合同范围。 底层承诺来自人工智能客户和其他行业的企业，但该公司并未透露具体身份。 较短的合同通常会带来较高的价格，CoreWeave 预计这将支持更高的利润，并帮助其为不愿签署较长协议的客户提供服务。

联合创始人兼首席开发官 Brannin McBee 表示：“这项交易展示了人工智能基础设施融资的持续发展和日益增长的灵活性，代表着 CoreWeave 的重大解锁。” “贷款人现在可以轻松地为短期合同融资，这使我们能够瞄准更广泛的客户，包括通常青睐短期协议的全球企业。”

在此次交易之前，CoreWeave 提供了 31 亿美元的 DDTL 5.0 贷款，该贷款于 5 月份完成，期限约为 5.5 年。 该债务的定价为 SOFR 加 450 个基点，使新贷款的利差扩大了 100 个基点。 两项交易分别获得穆迪和惠誉的 Ba2 和 BB+ 评级。

CoreWeave 表示，最新的交割使其 2026 年获得的债务和股权资本超过 300 亿美元。 总额包括股权和其他债务交易，而不仅仅是公司的延迟提取贷款。 CoreWeave 报告称，截至 3 月 31 日，积压收入为 988 亿美元，其定义涵盖剩余履约义务和其他承诺的合同金额。

延迟提取结构让 CoreWeave 在客户部署进行时为基础设施提供资金，而不是在交易结束时全额借入。 该公司没有提供提款时间表，也没有说明债务是否可以向母公司追索。

此次交易的联席牵头安排人和账簿管理人是摩根大通和三菱日联金融集团。 所得款项将用于购买和部署客户专用 GPU 基础设施。
